system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
I'm having trouble resetting my password, can anyone help

PREDICTED INTENT: login_access

PRECEDENTS:

[2516184] (similarity 0.73, intent login_access)
  past customer: hi, how can I get help w issues on on getting a password reset email
  spotify replied: Hey, helps here! Try resetting your password here: <link> Let us know if that works

[1024763] (similarity 0.72, intent login_access)
  past customer: Guys, I can't log in! The reset password page doesn't recognise my email, but says it is attached to an account
  spotify replied: Hey Hattie! You should be able to reset your password now. Can you give it another shot? Let us know how that goes

[1927089] (similarity 0.71, intent login_access)
  past customer: having problems accessing my account tried to reset password but no link has been received by email to do this.
  spotify replied: Hey Sarah, help's here! Can you try resetting your password at <link> using a private or incognito window?

[2202395] (similarity 0.68, intent login_access)
  past customer: can't login for some reason. It let me reset my password to the same thing 3 times in a row. All login info was triple checked
  spotify replied: Hey Brandon! Help's arrived. Are you getting any specific errors? If so, a screenshot will be really handy

[2708576] (similarity 0.67, intent login_access)
  past customer: Hello, I was suddenly logged out of my account today and am now unable to reset my password. My username is hannahbellbarnes and my email is __email__
  spotify replied: Hey Hannah! We're sorry to hear that. Check out <link> for what to do next
